snippets.output: Chlorhexidine is an antiseptic and disinfectant used for skin disinfection before surgery and to sterilize surgical instruments.
Chlorhexidine is effective against a wide range of bacteria, viruses, and fungi.
Chlorhexidine is available in various formulations, including solutions, gels, and impregnated dressings.
Chlorhexidine is commonly used in healthcare settings for hand hygiene and to prevent infections in central venous catheters.
